text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
It has long been said that the winner of 
the Kikuka Sho earns the title of "the 
strongest."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Ready to face Symboli Kris S, she resolved 
to seize the chrysanthemum crown—and true 
strength— with determination burning in 
her heart before the race.
